tool_input.summary:
Removed all concept UI from the Kit app in sketchpad. 3 edits in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx:

1. **Table row concept chips** — Removed concept Action buttons from both mobile and desktop Kit table rows. Concepts were rendered as clickable chips (with toggleConcept/selectedConcepts) next to artifact names.

2. **Concept-based table filtering** — Removed the selectedConcepts filter that hid design rows not matching selected concept GUIDs. Designs now show regardless of concept associations.

3. **useKitAppSelectAll** — Removed concepts from the select-all action so concepts are never programmatically selected in the Kit app.

Already clean (from previous work): KitDiagramNodeKind, ArtifactKind, KitKindToggles, KitCreateActions, buildKitDiagramData kindGroups, visibleGuids, diagram hover/selection handlers, detail panel sections, artifactKinds breadcrumb, isKitDiagramNodeKind guard.

Internal concept infrastructure preserved: useKitConcepts, concept selection hooks/commands, ConceptSection/ConceptFilter component definitions (not rendered), concept data on table rows (used by Home app), concept hover state.
